units._component_norm: single CSS-component bits divided by n
units._logical_norm: X/Z class bits divided by k; total class bits divided by 2k
units._dp: finite-difference derivative with respect to erasure probability

exact_x_error.description: Raw X-error posterior entropy in bits; equals |E| - rank(H_Z,E).

exact_z_error.description: Raw Z-error posterior entropy in bits; equals |E| - rank(H_X,E).

exact_error_total.description: Raw Pauli posterior entropy in bits.

exact_x_stabilizer.description: Dimension of X-type stabilizers supported inside E.

exact_z_stabilizer.description: Dimension of Z-type stabilizers supported inside E.

exact_x_class.description: X-correction-class entropy in bits; equals H(x_E | E,S) - dim S_X(E).

exact_z_class.description: Z-correction-class entropy in bits; equals H(z_E | E,s_X) - dim S_Z(E).

exact_x_saved_by_stabilizers.description: Exact X-side guess reduction from erased stabilizer degeneracy.

exact_z_saved_by_stabilizers.description: Exact Z-side guess reduction from erased stabilizer degeneracy.

exact_saved_by_stabilizers_total.description: Exact total guess reduction from erased stabilizer degeneracy.

peel_x_residual_qubits.description: Number of X-side erased qubits left unresolved by primal peeling.

peel_z_residual_qubits.description: Number of Z-side erased qubits left unresolved by primal peeling.

peel_residual_qubits_total.description: Total unresolved erased qubits left by primal peeling.

peel_x_unassisted_guess.description: Guess bits required after primal peeling without stabilizer aid; approximates H(x_E | E,S).

peel_z_unassisted_guess.description: Guess bits required after primal peeling without stabilizer aid; approximates H(z_E | E,s_X).

peel_unassisted_guess_total.description: Total unassisted peeling guess bits; approximates H(x_E,z_E | E,S).

peel_x_stabilizer_found.description: X-type erased stabilizers found by dual peeling.

peel_z_stabilizer_found.description: Z-type erased stabilizers found by dual peeling.

peel_stabilizer_found_total.description: Total erased stabilizers found by dual peeling.

peel_x_saved_guess.description: Algorithmic X-side guess reduction from stabilizer aid.

peel_z_saved_guess.description: Algorithmic Z-side guess reduction from stabilizer aid.

peel_saved_guess_total.description: Algorithmic total guess reduction from stabilizer aid.

peel_x_aided_guess.description: Guess bits required after stabilizer peeling and primal peeling; approximates H(C_X | E,S).

peel_z_aided_guess.description: Guess bits required after stabilizer peeling and primal peeling; approximates H(C_Z | E,s_X).

peel_aided_guess_total.description: Total guess bits required after stabilizer peeling and primal peeling; approximates H(C | E,S).

dual_primal_residual_total.description: Residual qubit count after stabilizer peeling followed by primal peeling.
